decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of brickwork, pointing and mortar repairs shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any external feature, except in so far as the repairs hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 5 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 6 - A brick sample shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of repair.
